content:
propose_request_cancellation cancels a request that has not executed, including an older approved or revoked request. It does not recall a payment already submitted to a bank.

Revoking an operator invalidates earlier approvals by changing that operator epoch; the immutable business arguments remain available for inspection. If a new operator needs to approve an obligation, support may cancel an obsolete draft and create a new correctly scoped proposal.
